name: Shell script directories
description: Sources every *.sh in one or two directories from every interactive shell, in a defined order — a workspace-relative project layer (.devcontainer/shell by default) and an optional absolute container path for personal scripts. The files are sourced live from ~/.bashrc rather than appended into it, so edits apply to the next new shell with no rebuild. Needs no configuration: the workspace-relative layer is resolved to a real path at create time.

projectDir.description: Workspace-relative directory of *.sh files, resolved to an absolute path at create time (or against $PROJECT_PATH at shell time, if that resolution could not happen). An absolute value is used as-is. Empty disables this layer.

userDir.description: Absolute container path holding personal *.sh files, sourced before the project layer. Empty (the default) disables this layer. This Feature neither creates nor mounts it — bind a host directory there from your own devcontainer.json.
